Medicine-03 - 
Diseases of the respiratory system - Upper respiratory tract infections.  Pneumonias.  Tuberculosis.  Lung abscess and bronchiectasis.  Diseases of the pleura: Pleurisy, Pleural effusion & empyema. Pneumothorax. Chronic Obstructive lung diseases and cor pulmonale.  Bronchial asthma & pulmonary eosinophilia. Acute and chronic respiratory failure. Neoplasm of the lung. 
Helminthic diseases - Nematodes, Trematodes.
